comparison.objective: Finish threaded inserts by breaking and recovering tangs; record safely sorts bottles in a crowded vertical rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed tool alignment, bimanual hammering, and tiny-part recovery; record requires collision-aware extraction, classification, and placement among constrained bottles.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fractures with inserts and shell intact; record requires correct bottle destinations without drops, collisions, or unsafe rack disturbance. Candidate numeric thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Crowded pick-and-place and sorting do not test controlled fracture or debris containment.
